products.name: XL Plus Series
tabs: The Deutsche Power XL Series consists of line-interactive uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) engineered by DP Electronics primarily for Small Office/Home Office (SOHO) setups, personal workstations, and light IT infrastructure.

Built with an internal transformer, these systems feature Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR) with Buck & Boost stabilization to smooth out intense grid voltage shifts without prematurely draining the battery.
The series accommodates a wide input voltage range—typically 140–300VAC.
It includes valuable operational features such as cold start capability, off-mode battery charging, and comprehensive safety protections against overloads, surges, and deep discharges.

assets/images/products/UPS/XL-Plus/PortGuide.png

products.name: XL Sine Series
tabs: XL Sine is a single-phase Line Interactive Sine Wave UPS with configurations ranging from 650VA to 3000VA.
The XL Series delivers a Pure sine wave output with a swift transfer time of 2–6 milliseconds during a utility failure.

Users can monitor real-time metrics—including input/output voltages, frequency tracking, and battery capacity—via a clear front-panel LCD screen or remotely through integrated USB and RS-232 communication interfaces.

This balance of digital monitoring, voltage stabilization, and reliable emergency battery backup makes the lineup an ideal, cost-effective solution for safeguarding desktop computers, internet routers, POS terminals, and peripheral network equipment.

products.name: Elentra Series LiFePO4
tabs: The Deutsche Power Elentra Series consists of pure sine wave line-interactive uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) engineered by DP Electronics primarily for domestic loads, IT systems, and network equipment.
Built with energy-efficient Green Mode architecture, these systems deliver clean, stable power protection for everyday home and office electronics while minimizing standby energy consumption.
The series spans a 1–8 kVA capacity range and offers flexible standard or extended battery autonomy options alongside adjustable charging currents.

It includes valuable operational features such as real-time LCD monitoring, intelligent battery management, and compliance with EN55022 and GB9254 standards for reliable, interference-free performance.

products.name: Elektra Series 1/1
tabs: The Deutsche Power Elektra Series 1/1 consists of online double-conversion uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) engineered by DP Electronics primarily for mission-critical single-phase IT systems and server rooms.
Built with true double-conversion topology and precise Digital Signal Processor (DSP) control, these systems deliver zero transfer time and seamless power continuity against severe grid disturbances.
The series spans a 1–20 kVA capacity range and provides broad generator compatibility to ensure uninterrupted operation during extended utility outages.

It includes valuable operational features such as optional network connectivity cards, comprehensive international safety compliance (IEC62040-1, EN62040, CE), and advanced electronic protections against surges and overloads.

products.name: Elektra Series 3/1
tabs: The Deutsche Power Elektra Series 3/1 consists of online double-conversion uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) engineered by DP Electronics primarily for mission-critical three-phase-input, single-phase-output IT environments.
Built to balance three-phase utility feeds while isolating sensitive single-phase loads, these systems provide continuous power conditioning for high-density enterprise data setups.
The series spans a 10–20 kVA capacity range and handles demanding power fluctuations with zero transfer time and pure sine wave output.

It includes valuable operational features such as advanced system monitoring, robust surge and overload protections, and compliance with key international EMC and safety standards including CE, FCC, and EN62040.

products.name: Elektra Series 3/3
tabs: The Deutsche Power Elektra Series 3/3 consists of online double-conversion uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) engineered by DP Electronics primarily for three-phase data centers and critical large-scale installations.
Built for high-availability infrastructure, these systems deliver continuous power conditioning and scalable capacity to safeguard enterprise facilities against utility outages and voltage spikes.
The series spans a wide 10–500 kVA capacity range and supports multi-unit parallel redundancy for fault-tolerant power distribution.
It includes valuable operational features such as comprehensive system monitoring, intelligent battery management, and robust protections against heavy electrical faults and deep discharges.

products.name: Elektra One
tabs: The Deutsche Power Elektra One consists of online double-conversion uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) engineered by DP Electronics primarily for telecommunications infrastructure, IT equipment, and critical single-phase loads.
Built with a specialized 48 V DC architecture, the system optimizes direct integration with standard 48 V battery banks while maintaining a compact tower footprint.
Rated at 6 kVA, the unit delivers continuous, zero-transfer-time power conditioning tailored for space-constrained, high-density IT setups.

It includes valuable operational features such as pure sine wave output, intelligent battery charging management, and comprehensive electronic safeguards against overloads, surges, and deep battery discharges.

products.name: Elektra Series 3/3
tabs: The Deutsche Power Elektra Series 3/3 (200) consists of IT-grade, high-frequency online double-conversion uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) engineered by DP Electronics primarily for data centers, medical diagnostic labs, and enterprise IT infrastructure.

Built with a compact footprint and full DSP digital control, these systems deliver zero transfer time (0 ms), an active input power factor above 0.99, and up to 94% operational efficiency (exceeding 98% in ECO mode).
The topology supports 100% unbalanced load capacity and broad generator synchronization to maintain surge-free power across fluctuating utility grids.
It includes valuable operational capabilities suited for demanding environments, including hyperscale data centers, telecom VoIP nodes, railway control systems, and automated industrial plants.

products.name: Elentra SC Series
tabs: The Deutsche Power Elentra SC Series consists of online double-conversion pure sinewave uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) engineered by DP Electronics primarily for mission-critical surveillance, networking, traffic, and security infrastructure.

The series spans 1 kVA to 8 kVA (1/1) models with a wide 110–300VAC input voltage window, 0ms transfer time in battery mode, up to 94–96% efficiency in ECO mode, and daisy-chainable external battery packs or LiFePO4 battery compatibility.

products.name: Elektra Series Outdoor UPS

Built with a weatherproof outdoor cabinet featuring IP55/65 protection, corrosion-resistant galvanized steel, sun and thermal insulation, and SPWM microprocessor control, these systems operate reliably across harsh climates from -40°C to +70°C.
The series spans 1 kVA to 10 kVA (1/1) models with 0ms transfer time, wide input voltage and generator-compatible frequency ranges, and support for both lead-acid and LiFePO4 batteries.

It includes valuable operational features such as lightning protection, optional air-conditioning or heat-exchanger and heater temperature control, anti-theft security, and remote monitoring via RS232, SNMP, and dry contacts.
